label: Interactive polish
tagline: Post-pass enrichment — microanimations, scroll/pointer effects, hover surprises, shader overlays — the planner identifies WHERE; the drawers decide WHAT
description: The SEVENTH planner sibling, with a DIFFERENT pipeline position. The other six run as the user's FIRST action (chat-Claude dispatches them up-front); this one runs LAST — after another primary planner's build phase has completed (or after chat-Claude has hand-written source), AFTER any content/structure is in place, BEFORE Step-8 QA. Reads existing source HTML/CSS/JS + the committed genre/aesthetic, identifies SITES of opportunity for interactive enrichment, commits a polish register (subtle / playful / theatrical based on genre), and dispatches drawers per opportunity type. THE LOAD-BEARING DISCIPLINE: the planner identifies WHERE + WHAT-TYPE of opportunity (microanimation / scroll-or-pointer-driven / hover-surprise / shader-overlay); the DRAWERS decide WHAT the specific improvement looks like (which microanimation, which shader effect, which hover reveal). Polish is a craft decision; if the planner pre-decides, drawers become rubber-stampers and quality drops. Operates on the whole project — no slot tag, no per-slot fanout. Writes supplemental files to source/<branch>/_polish/<polishId>/ so existing source stays intact; the runtime drawer writes integration-instructions.md describing the minimal <link>/<script> edits the caller applies to each host page. Heavily co-dispatches visual-planner with the shader skill for procedural overlays (halftone print, CRT scanlines, paper grain, glitch, dither). Drawers MAY be skipped — only the opportunity types research flagged dispatch. Pieces that are already richly interactive may commit siteCount=0 (a legitimate outcome).

triggers.title: Path A — after another primary planner's build phase (the canonical trigger)
triggers.rule: After chat-Claude has driven the build phase of sim/im/nx/game/scrapbook/visual planner work to completion, BEFORE invoking Step-8 QA, chat-Claude dispatches interactive-polish-planner with project-wide scope. The planner walks the resulting source, identifies enrichment sites per the genre, and commits a polish pass. This is the POST-PASS trigger — chat-Claude treats polish as the last build-phase step before the QA wrap-up.

triggers.title: Path B — explicit user request
triggers.rule: User says 'polish this', 'make it feel more alive', 'add micro-interactions', 'the vibe needs more depth', or 'feels static / dead / generic'. Chat-Claude dispatches interactive-polish-planner directly.
